details: The visualization uses the unified Pointer Events API (pointermove/pointerenter/pointerleave), avoiding mouse-touch conflicts, and the pointermove handler performs only lightweight attribute updates on a handful of pre-existing elements rather than a full data join or re-render, keeping the update storm risk negligible. No transitions, cross-view dispatchers, or zoom/brush interactions are present, so infinite loops, stale closures, and handoff races are non-issues.
